summary: First post-import test (SDK 58). Backend: 21/21 pytest pass when run serially (repo suite + new extra suite). Under the configured xdist (-n 2 --dist loadscope) one repo test is flaky due to a cross-worker race in the repo's own test fixtures, not an app bug. Frontend: login screen renders at / -> /login with 'Masuk dengan Google' (testID login-google), no bundle errors. CRITICAL bug found and fixed: tapping any bottom tab crashed with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading emit)' in src/components/tab-bar.tsx because SDK 58 expo-router bottom tabs pass {emitter, navigateToTab} to tabBar instead of {navigation}. After the fix, dashboard/pesanan/customer/ekspor tabs, FAB->pesanan-baru, stok-barang, supplier and logout all work with an injected session token. Unauth /dashboard redirects to /login; invalid token is cleared.

minor.issue: The session-scoped autouse seed_qa_users fixture runs once per xdist worker and deletes app_data for both QA users. With -n 2 --dist loadscope, TestIsolation.test_user2_write_isolated_from_user1 is flaky because it also relies on user1 data written by TestData, which may run on another worker. Passes reliably with -n 0.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: tapping a tab crashed the app (red screen) with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading emit)'. SDK 58 BottomTabBarProps = {state, descriptors, emitter, navigateToTab, insets}, so there is no `navigation` prop. Patched to use emitter/navigateToTab, falling back to navigation.

react_native_issues.issue: The custom tabBar used the removed `navigation.emit/navigate` props, which broke under the SDK 58 upgrade. Now uses `emitter.emit` + `navigateToTab(route.key)`. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/tab-bar.tsx:18-50

action_items: Review the tab-bar.tsx SDK 58 fix (emitter/navigateToTab) and keep it. Also check for any other custom navigator code that depends on react-navigation `navigation` props.
Optional: make test_lpm_backend.py safe under xdist (e.g. seed and clean data per class, and remove the TestIsolation dependency on TestData) so it doesn't flake with -n 2 --dist loadscope.
Optional: run `npx expo install --check`, since Metro reports expo 58.0.17 -> ~58.0.19 plus 3 other packages that may need updating.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py hardcodes EMERGENT_SESSION_URL and frontend AUTH_BASE. This is acceptable for the Emergent auth integration.
Backend uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown (works, but lifespan is preferred).
No deprecated expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) found; no RN SafeAreaView usage.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after tab-bar fix (tabs crashed before fix)

seed_data_creation: Repo tests seed users qa.lpm@example.com (user_qa0000000001, token qa-token-123) and qa2.lpm@example.com (user_qa0000000002, token qa-token-456) in Mongo. qa-token-123 was deleted by the frontend logout test; rerun the pytest to re-seed. The extra suite cleans up its own TEST_ user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -n 0`. Frontend auth: localStorage key 'lpm_session_token' = a session token seeded in user_sessions. The frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Do not tap testID reset-demo (wipes data).
rca_of_issue: Tab crash: expo-router 58's forked bottom-tabs calls tabBar({state, descriptors, emitter, navigateToTab, insets}) (node_modules/expo-router/build/react-navigation/bottom-tabs/views/BottomTabView.js:209). The repo code (SDK 57) destructured `navigation`, which is now undefined, so `navigation.emit` threw on press. Mitigation: use emitter/navigateToTab, falling back to navigation.
